input.report: Both of my invoices were paid in full. INV-001 (Acme Paper Co, V-100, invoice A-7781, USD 640) and INV-002 (Bluebird Courier, V-101, invoice BB-2210, USD 275) each met all payment criteria: both vendors are approved with active accounts, both amounts are within their per-invoice caps (1500 and 800 respectively), and a cache check confirmed no prior claims or results existed for either invoice. I filed claims for both, recorded payments PAY-0001 and PAY-0002 in the ledger, sent remittance advice to ap@acme.vendor.example and billing@bluebird.vendor.example, and wrote paid results to the shared cache. No invoices were declined.
